title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices.

summaryHtml: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment requiring the Supreme Court to be composed of nine Justices—one Chief Justice and eight Associate Justices.
